description: This file defines a set of helper functions for throwing standard exceptions in a consistent manner, especially useful in header-only libraries and template code that may be compiled with or without exceptions enabled.

methods.name: ThrowStdLogicError
methods.description: Throws a std::logic_error exception with the provided message.

methods.name: ThrowStdInvalidArgument
methods.description: Throws a std::invalid_argument exception with the provided message.
